fact: Benin's Treasury (DGTCP) says its Centre d'Ecoute Clients has been in a pilot phase since July 2024, taking complaints by phone, email, web form and a physical counter, with the IT complaints-management system still in production and to be deployed soon.
system: Centre d'Ecoute Clients (CEC) du Tresor public

fact: The commune of Adjarra launched the Doton mobile app on 14 February 2025 for citizens to file complaints and suggestions about communal services, with status tracking and a dedicated unit in the town hall, but the article gives no count of complaints received.

The Government of Benin states its complaints and denunciations platform denonciation.bj and toll-free line 155 are operational, run by a national cell created by decree 2022-040, taking reports of corruption, poor governance and violations by public agents.
The Médiateur de la République of Benin launched online submission of complaints (saisine en ligne) on 14 November 2023, with no count of complaints received online.
